findings.title: No-op evidence index in linkFinding
findings.detail: `final imageIndex = evidenceCount > 0 ? 0 : 0;` evaluates to 0 on both branches, so the `evidenceCount` parameter has no effect on the index. Behavior is correct (always the primary image) but the ternary should be simplified to a plain `const imageIndex = 0;` so intent is not misread as index logic.

findings.title: Raw error interpolated into Save-failure SnackBar
findings.detail: `reportSaveFailedMessage(Object error) => 'Could not save inspection report: $error'` surfaces the exception's toString in a user-facing toast. This is the Save action, not the gated analysis/offline path (which correctly uses VeriqooErrorState), but a fixed friendly string would be better polish.

findings.title: Unused string constant ResultStrings.extractRowPending
findings.detail: `extractRowPending ('—')` is defined but never referenced; the processing rows use `extractRowReading`. Remove it or use it. Harmless dead copy; does not affect analyze.

findings.title: Success-path pushReplacement inside the catch scope
findings.detail: The success-path `context.pushReplacement('/scan/result')` sits inside the same try whose catch-all sets the error flag, so a (very unlikely) throw from navigation after a successful analysis would render ANALYSIS INTERRUPTED. In practice pushReplacement does not throw here; consider moving the push past the try as a style improvement.
